title: fanoutqa: What are the capital cities of the countries that hosted the 5 most recent Olympics? (d2049103e53dbeb5)

chat_history.content: What are the capital cities of the countries that hosted the 5 most recent Olympics?

content.content:
We need the capital cities of the countries that hosted the 5 most recent Olympics. Which Olympics? Likely Summer Olympics? Could be both Summer and Winter? Usually "the Olympics" could refer to Summer Olympics. The 5 most recent Summer Olympics as of now (2025) are: 2024 Paris (upcoming), 2020 Tokyo (held 2021), 2016 Rio de Janeiro, 2012 London, 2008 Beijing. But 2024 hasn't happened yet; but host city known. So we need capital cities of the countries: France (Paris) -> capital Paris (same), Japan (Tokyo) -> capital Tokyo, Brazil (Rio) -> capital Brasília, United Kingdom (London) -> capital London, China (Beijing) -> capital Beijing. But note that capital of France is Paris, yes. For Japan, capital is Tokyo. Brazil's capital is Brasília. UK capital is London. China's capital is Beijing. So list them.

Alternatively could include Winter Olympics? The 5 most recent Winter Olympics: 2022 Beijing, 2018 Pyeongchang (South Korea), 2014 Sochi (Russia), 2010 Vancouver (Canada), 2006 Turin (Italy). Capitals: China Beijing, South Korea Seoul, Russia Moscow, Canada Ottawa, Italy Rome. Which interpretation? The question ambiguous. Might answer both. Provide clarification.

I'll answer assuming Summer Olympics, but note also winter.

content:
Below are the capital cities of the nations that have hosted the **five most recent Summer Olympic Games** (the 2024 Games in Paris are already confirmed, even though they have not yet taken place).

| Olympic year | Host city | Host country | Capital city of that country |
|--------------|-----------|--------------|------------------------------|
| 2024 | Paris | **France** | **Paris** |
| 2020* (held 2021) | Tokyo | **Japan** | **Tokyo** |
| 2016 | Rio de Janeiro | **Brazil** | **Brasília** |
| 2012 | London | **United Kingdom** | **London** |
| 2008 | Beijing | **China** | **Beijing** |

\*The 2020 Summer Olympics were postponed to 2021 because of the COVID‑19 pandemic, but they are still officially referred to as the “2020 Olympics.”

---

### (Optional) If you meant the Winter Olympics

For completeness, here are the capital cities of the countries that hosted the **five most recent Winter Olympic Games**:

| Olympic year | Host city | Host country | Capital city |
|--------------|-----------|--------------|--------------|
| 2022 | Beijing | **China** | **Beijing** |
| 2018 | Pyeongchang | **South Korea** | **Seoul** |
| 2014 | Sochi | **Russia** | **Moscow** |
| 2010 | Vancouver | **Canada** | **Ottawa** |
| 2006 | Turin | **Italy** | **Rome** |

Let me know if you need any additional details!
